title: Logs filters are two rows of chips across the top, and Status offers choices with 0 results
where: /admin/sessions/<code>/logs, 1440px, any session (seen on evolving-why-statement and on an empty session)
what_happens: Status and Kind are two always-open chip rows above the list. Status always lists error, parse_error and stream_aborted even at 0 (evolving-why-statement: error 0, parse_error 0, stream_aborted 0); on a session with no calls every Status chip reads 0. Labels are raw codes (parse_error, stream_aborted).
who_hurts: Dane checking a session's AI calls: two rows of filter chips push the list down, and three of the four status choices lead to an empty list.
suggested_fix: Put Status and Kind behind one 'Filter' dropdown next to the 'Showing 200 of 522' line; build the Status options from statuses with a count > 0 (as the Kind chips already do via kindsPresent, logs/page.tsx:118); show active filters (and the participant filter) as small removable chips. Plain labels: 'Error', 'Couldn't read reply', 'Cut off'.
rule: Dane's UI rule: 'Filters stay tucked away, not spread across the top of the page. Put them behind one "Filter" button or dropdown ... Only offer choices that exist in the data.'
origin: earlier: PR #3/#4 fixed the Kind chips but left Status and the layout
